The stated drivers are that written-first is cleaner than drip-feeding responses, adds two days of lead time that the service agreement can absorb, and avoids the failure mode you saw in February, when an all-live mediation without written positions led to re-litigating history, escalation, and a director walking out. With mediation volume up because of the reorganization, you also see the format choice as more consequential.
